subject: sepulcra
title: Shamblers die as ragdolls
note: A shambler killed on a path in a real game (seed 7, wave 1) falls as a ragdoll on hull parts, knocked back from where it faced, and lies on its back; the motion checks pass (penetration 2.8 cm, floating 0, pops 1.3 cm). Before this, shamblers played a death clip.

images.caption: 2 s later: lying on its back on the path
